round: V36 step 1: screen a finer split of stage 3 (6144 and above) by fitting realised scores
motivation: Stage 3 holds every position from the first 6144 to 12288 in one table set, from rebuilding with small cards to the final 6144+3072+1536+768 chain. Earlier stage-3 work (V27, V28, V31, V32, V33) never split it. V33 ruled out other shapes of the same size, not more capacity; a split by the second-largest card is a cheap form of capacity that the stage design already uses for stages 0-2.

data.records: V33 records (training/v33-patterns/data/*.bin, 300 files): stage-3 afterstates of W31 website-search games from the 14,956 V27 training starts, 2 passes, every 2nd afterstate, target G = realised future score
data.limitation: collected under the old independent 1/21 bonus rule (before V35); the screen asks about representation, so the rule difference is accepted for this step

fit: training/v36-substage/fit.cpp: V33 fit.cpp unchanged except that the residual tables are indexed by the sub-stage group. Same fixed base (dist/models/ntuple-v23.bin stage 3 = V21 S3 four-cell table), same validation split (start index % 5 == 0), same SGD (4 epochs .003/.001/.0003/.0001, seed 33), best validation epoch. Residual shapes: V29-V31 P5 five-cell set for every candidate.

candidates.none: one P5 table set (control; must reproduce V33 P5 validation MSE exactly)
candidates.four: second < 1536 | 1536 | 3072 without 1536+768 | 3072+1536+768 present (the "final 768" chain) or a second 6144
candidates.bias3: shared P5 tables + one bias per "three" group (control: how much of a gain is just a per-group level)

secondLargest: largest rank on the afterstate after removing one 6144 card
comparison: per validation start index, sum of squared errors; paired difference vs none: mean, SE, z (V33 method). Relative gain = (MSE_none - MSE_X) / (MSE_NONE_base_only - MSE_none), MSE_NONE_base_only from V33.
decision: Go to TD training (a separate, later protocol, with each sub-stage started from the current stage-3 tables and a low rate) with the best of two/three/four only if it beats none with z > 2 and relative gain >= 5% (the V33 bar). Otherwise stop. bias3 is reported but cannot trigger go; if bias3 gets most of the best split's gain, the follow-up must say so.
